content: METHODOLOGICAL LESSON, cannabis FOR/AGAINST pass 2026-05-18, generalizes beyond cannabis. The symmetric-evidence standard finally bit in the direction that is hardest to feel: toward the SKEPTICS own blind spot, not the advocates. The adversarial steelman established the work had a genuine skeptical-direction tilt on the pain framing -- foregrounding the 2026 Cochrane >=50% null over the moderate-certainty Wang small-effect finding IS a tier-error, just mirror-imaged from advocacy overreach. The steelman of the critique was the STRONGER argument there and that was stated plainly rather than balanced away. Reusable principle: a project built to resist advocacy overreach develops a characteristic opposite failure mode -- treating the strictest threshold null as a global null -- and this is invisible from inside the skeptical frame precisely because it feels like rigor. The check that caught it was steelman-both with an explicit pre-committed self-test (would the best advocate of each side recognize their argument; fairness measured by advocate-recognition not by display of evenhandedness). The self-test passing looked like declaring one side stronger, NOT like a midpoint. Carry into all future adversarial synthesis: false balance and over-sharpening-the-disfavored-side are BOTH performances; the only non-performance is letting the stronger argument be stronger on the record even when it indicts your own posture.
